reference.title: Two new AM Canum Venaticorum binaries from the Sloan Digital Sky Survey III
reference.locator: Section 3.1 and Figure 2; Table 3 gives SDSS J1137 subspectrum HJD values.

peak_estimator: Local maxima inspected in the native array; rounded two-decimal sample locations, not fitted centroids or radial velocities.
interpretation: Published helium-emission binary context explains why these positive native features must be retained. The positional and spectral agreement supports this literature counterpart; neither the tentative MWDD DQ: label nor automated SDSS QSO z=0.076256 is adopted as a new physical classification. This source is not a clean single photospheric DQ-opacity control.
limits: No new binary discovery, orbital measurement, source-association probability, or population contamination fraction. No blanket line removal. Original catalogue labels and numerical colour remain traceable.
